battle_traits.name: Paragons Of Slaanesh
battle_traits.declare: If there are fewer than 3 friendly PARAGONS on the battlefield, pick a friendly HEDONITES OF SLAANESH unit that does not have the PARAGON keyword and has not had the PARAGON keyword this battle to be the target.
battle_traits.effect: The target gains the PARAGON keyword.

options.name: Designer’s Note
options.text: Friendly units with the PARAGON keyword on their warscroll count towards the number of friendly PARAGONS on the battlefield. If there are more than 3 friendly PARAGONS on the battlefield at the same time, you must immediately remove those units from the battlefield one at a time until there are only 3 friendly PARAGONS left on the battlefield.

battle_traits.name: Fall From Grace
battle_traits.effect:
A friendly non-UNIQUE PARAGON immediately loses the PARAGON keyword when any of the following happen:

• That PARAGON has 3 or more damage points allocated to it by the same use of a non-ATTACK ability.
• That PARAGON uses a CHARGE ability and the unmodified charge roll is 5 or less (after any re-rolls).
• A spell cast by that PARAGON is miscast (after any re-rolls).

battle_traits.name: Sensuous Arcana
battle_traits.declare: Pick a friendly non-UNIQUE PARAGON that has successfully cast a spell this turn and has not used a TEMPTATION ability this turn to use this ability.
battle_traits.effect: Until the start of your next turn, while the unit using this ability is a PARAGON, add 1 to casting rolls for visible friendly HEDONITES OF SLAANESH units while they are wholly within 12" of the unit using this ability.

battle_traits.name: Cutting Barbs
battle_traits.declare: Pick a friendly HEDONITES OF SLAANESH HERO that has not used a TEMPTATION ability this turn to use this ability. Then, pick an enemy unit in combat with that HERO to be the target.
battle_traits.effect: If the unit using this ability is a PARAGON, pick 1 of the effects below. Otherwise, your opponent must pick 1 of the effects below.

options.name: Rise to the Insults
options.text: For the rest of the turn, the target has a maximum control score of 1.

options.name: Turn Aside from the Insults
options.text: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the hit rolls for attacks made by friendly HEDONITES OF SLAANESH units that target that enemy unit.

battle_traits.name: Beguiling Glance
battle_traits.declare: Pick a friendly HEDONITES OF SLAANESH HERO unit that has not used a TEMPTATION ability this turn to use this ability. Then, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of that HERO to be the target.
battle_traits.effect: If the unit using this ability is a PARAGON, pick 1 of the effects below. Otherwise, your opponent must pick 1 of the effects below.

options.name: Succumb
options.text: For the rest of the turn, when the target is using a CHARGE ability, it must end that charge move no further from the HERO using this ability.

options.name: Resist
options.text: For the rest of the turn, subtract 2 from charge rolls for the target.

battle_traits.name: Chief Of Revels
battle_traits.declare: Pick a friendly non-UNIQUE PARAGON that charged this turn and has not used a TEMPTATION ability this turn to use this ability.
battle_traits.effect: Until the start of your next turn, while the unit using this ability is a PARAGON, add 2 to charge rolls for friendly HEDONITES OF SLAANESH units while they are wholly within 12" of the unit using this ability.

battle_traits.name: Enthralling Vanity
battle_traits.declare: Pick a friendly HEDONITES OF SLAANESH HERO unit that has not used a TEMPTATION ability this turn to use this ability. Then, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of that HERO to be the target.
battle_traits.effect: If the unit using this ability is a PARAGON pick 1 of the effects below. Otherwise your opponent must pick 1 of the effects below.

options.name: Mesmerized
options.text: For the rest of the turn, weapons used by friendly HEDONITES OF SLAANESH units for attacks that target that unit, including Companion weapons, have Crit (2 Hits).

options.name: Break their Gaze
options.text: For the rest of the turn, other than the Companion ability, weapon abilities for combat attacks made by the target have no effect.

battle_traits.name: Excess Of Agility
battle_traits.declare: Pick a friendly non-UNIQUE PARAGON that has not used a TEMPTATION ability this turn to use this ability.
battle_traits.effect: For the rest of the turn, while the unit using this ability is a PARAGON and is in combat, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target visible friendly HEDONITES OF SLAANESH units while they are wholly within 12" of the unit using this ability.

abilities.name: In Search Of Sin
abilities.declare: Pick up to 3 friendly HEDONITES OF SLAANESH INFANTRY units to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Each target can move D6". It can only end that move in combat with units it was in combat with at the start of the move.

abilities.name: Sadistic Tendencies
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly HEDONITES OF SLAANESH unit to use this ability, then pick an enemy unit in combat with that unit and that had any damage points allocated to it this turn to be the target.
abilities.effect:
For the rest of the turn:
• All of the combat attacks made by that friendly unit must target that enemy unit.
• Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of that friendly unit's melee weapons.

abilities.name: Godly Spoor
abilities.effect: While they are wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge, friendly HEDONITES OF SLAANESH units can use CHARGE abilities even if they used a RUN ability in the same turn.

abilities.name: Amidst The Phantasmagoria
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly HEDONITES OF SLAANESH unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by an enemy ability to be the target.
abilities.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield, then set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Prodigy of Excess
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly HEDONITES OF SLAANESH HERO that has an artefact of power to be the target.
abilities.effect: Give the target a heroic trait from the 'Figureheads of the Dark Prince' or 'Hedonistic Obsessions' tables.

options.name: Designer’s Note
options.text: This heroic trait is given to the target during the deployment phase, not during army composition.

abilities.name: Ecstatic Revellers
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly SYBARITE INFANTRY units while they are wholly outside friendly territory

entries.name: Centre Of Attention
entries.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.
entries.effect:
Roll a dice. On a 3+, for the rest of the turn, while this unit is wholly within 12" of the centre of the battlefield and visible to the target:


• Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks made by that enemy unit that target other friendly HEDONITES OF SLAANESH units.
• Add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by other friendly HEDONITES OF SLAANESH units that target that enemy unit.

entries.name: Dilettante
entries.effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

entries.name: Unseemly Vitality
entries.effect: Heal (D3) this unit.

entries.name: Celebrity Warlord
entries.declare: Pick a friendly non-HERO SYBARITE unit that has been destroyed to be the target.
entries.effect: Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) wholly within 12" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.

entries.name: Master of Temptation
entries.declare: You can only use this ability if your opponent has any temptation dice. Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target.
entries.effect: For the rest of the turn, while your opponent has not used any of their temptation dice to replace a roll for the target this turn, the target can only use CORE abilities.

entries.name: The Need For Perfection
entries.effect: The first time each turn that an unmodified charge roll, casting roll, unbinding roll or banishment roll for a friendly non-EUPHORIC unit wholly within 12" of this unit is 5 or less, that unit has the EUPHORIC keyword for the rest of the turn.

entries.name: Agonisingly Elusive
entries.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
entries.effect:
If it is your turn, apply the effect below. If it is your opponent's turn, roll a dice. On a 3+, apply the effect below:
Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. Then, this unit must move a distance up to its Move characteristic. It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units but cannot end that move in combat.

entries.name: Incensed
entries.declare: Pick an objective within 6" of this unit to be the target.
entries.effect: Until the start of your next turn, friendly HEDONITES OF SLAANESH units are not visible to enemy units more than 9" from them while all models in those friendly units are contesting the target objective.

entries.name: Arcane Magnetism
entries.effect: If this unit has 3 or more damage points, it can use a SPELL ability as if it were your hero phase, as if that ability had the UNLIMITED keyword and as if this unit had WIZARD (1).

entries.name: Bashful Visage
entries.effect: While they are wholly within 6" of this unit, friendly non-MONSTER non-WAR MACHINE HEDONITES OF SLAANESH units are not visible to enemy units more than 12" from them.

entries.name: Crown Of The Ur-Slaanesh
entries.declare: Pick a friendly non-HERO INFANTRY HEDONITES OF SLAANESH unit that has been destroyed to be the target.
entries.effect: Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) wholly within 12" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.

entries.name: The Rod Of Misrule
entries.declare: Pick another visible friendly HEDONITES OF SLAANESH unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
entries.effect: For the rest of the turn, when the target uses the 'Power Through' command, you can pick an enemy target for that command that does not have a lower Health characteristic than the unit using that command.

entries.name: Obsession with Control
entries.declare: Pick an objective to be the target.
entries.effect:
For the rest of the battle, while this unit is contesting the target objective:
• This unit has WARD (5+).
• Add 5 to this unit's control score.

entries.name: Obsession with Form
entries.timing: Reaction: You declared the 'Run' ability for this unit
entries.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target this unit for the rest of the turn.

entries.name: Obsession with Pain
entries.effect: If this unit is damaged, spend 1 rage dice. If your opponent's fury level is lower than yours, they must increase their fury level by 1, to a maximum of 7. Then, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit's non-COMPANION melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

entries.name: Hysterical Frenzy
entries.declare: Pick a friendly HEDONITES OF SLAANESH WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly HEDONITES OF SLAANESH unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for the target's combat attacks until the start of your next turn.

entries.name: Last Ecstasy
entries.declare: Pick a friendly HEDONITES OF SLAANESH WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly HEDONITES OF SLAANESH unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Until the start of your next turn, each time a model in the target unit is slain by a combat attack and that model was in combat with the attacking unit, roll a dice. If the target unit is a MONSTER, roll 10 dice instead. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the FIGHT ability has been resolved.

entries.name: Overwhelming Acquiescence
entries.declare: Pick a friendly HEDONITES OF SLAANESH WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Until the start of your next turn, weapons used by friendly HEDONITES OF SLAANESH units for attacks that target that enemy unit, including Companion weapons, have Crit (2 Hits).

entries.name: Summon Dreadful Visage
entries.declare: If there is not a friendly Dreadful Visage on the battlefield, pick a friendly HEDONITES OF SLAANESH WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Set up a Dreadful Visage wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

entries.name: Summon Mesmerising Mirror
entries.declare: If there is not a friendly Mesmerising Mirror on the battlefield, pick a friendly HEDONITES OF SLAANESH WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Set up a Mesmerising Mirror wholly within 12" of the caster and visible to them.

entries.name: Summon Wheels of Excruciation
entries.declare: If there is not a friendly Wheels of Excruciation endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly HEDONITES OF SLAANESH WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Set up a Wheels of Excruciation endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.
